name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the box to be in the agent's hands when reaching the exit (carry the box to the exit). The current clauses only enforce that the exit cannot be reached before the box is first picked up (Precedence) but do not guarantee the box is still held at the exit. Add a hard rule to require holding_box at the moment of at_exit, e.g., a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) (or an equivalent clause) so that every finish includes holding_box at the exit.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: The three hard clauses exactly capture the task – reach the exit, be holding the box at the exit, and re‑pick the box after any fall – and the machine reflects them correctly.

texts: Whenever the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box
Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up again
